about: Instruction patches applied to ffxivgame.exe 2012.09.19.0001 before translation (recomp --patches). Addresses and our own replacement instructions only. The same changes Garlemald Client (and the original Seventh Umbral launcher) make to the exe in memory or on disk.

patches.why: mov eax, 0x50E0E812 in place of the call that reads the host's Unix time for the lobby's encryption time: pinned to 2012-12-31 01:19:14 UTC, as the servers' SERVER_UTC expects (a present-day clock is rejected as far in its future, and the lobby stops after the account list)
a byte getter called with this = NULL from one of its callers (after the boat cinematic): test ecx first and return 0 through the out pointer
mov byte ptr [esi+0x20], 0 with the same uninitialized member as the getter above: the store is dropped

the character setting nohide_action (keep the action bar up outside active mode) defaults to 1: inc byte ptr [esp+0xb48] in place of the 8-byte mov of 3 into the same unwind-state byte (it holds 2 here), which frees the byte for push 1 as the default ahead of max 1, min 0 and the two slot arguments. A character's saved game settings still win.

the character setting logwin_trans1 (the main log window's transparency, 0 solid to 10 clear) defaults to 2 in place of 3: push 2 as the default ahead of max 10 and min 0. The chat was hard to read over bright scenes. A character's saved game settings still win.
logwin_trans2 (the second log window's transparency) defaults to 6 in place of 7, the same way
the character setting vulgar (the profanity filter) defaults to 0, off, in place of 1: push 0 as the default ahead of max 1 and min 0

the sound engine's FilterBase::CalculateLowPassCoefficients (0xB656B0) asserts freq <= 0.25 (a share of the sample rate) and the assert handler then writes to address 0 on purpose, so the whole client dies. Zoning out right after killing monsters can hand it a cutoff above 0.25 or NaN (seen going 157 -> 155 and 172 -> 209 after !kill). Clamp freq to 0.25 in place (fld 0.25; fcomp [esp+0xc]; fnstsw ax; test ah,1 also catches NaN; je over mov dword [esp+0xc], 0x3E800000) and NOP the rest of the assert call, so the filter is computed at its highest cutoff in place of crashing.
